title: Stop Saying "Very Tasty"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very tasty". Use one of these words instead:
• Delicious: The soup is delicious
• Mouth-watering: It looks mouth-watering
• Scrumptious: The cake is scrumptious
